records.name: Deadly Dance
records.skill_description: A fast melee rush that sends the user forward through a series of punches and kicks before an upward finishing kick.
records.mechanics_notes: Xenoverse 2 documentation describes Deadly Dance as a melee attack that can eliminate weak Ki Blasts. Independent gameplay descriptions identify the move as a fast multi-hit Strike Super with an upward final kick and combo-extension utility.
records.acquisition_notes: Android 18's Lesson 2 is the canonical Future Warrior acquisition route. Later updates allow Deadly Dance to be equipped to Krillin's customizable partner skillset after purchase through Partner Customization.
records.pve_notes: Mentor-training acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast multi-hit Strike Super with combo-extension utility; detailed frame and matchup claims are not encoded as canonical numeric data.
